choices.name: Animal Wrangler
effects: Automatically banks fish when Fishing and Hunter loot when hunting.
2% chance of a random farm animal when Hunting or Fishing (toggle Manor Farm or Anachronia Dinosaur Farm).
33% chance of a random clean herb, herb seed, tree seed, or fruit tree seed (sent to bank) when Fishing, Hunting, or harvesting farm animals.
Farm animals always have 100% stats and never get hungry.
Farm animal buyers always pay the highest bean price regardless of age or disease.
Hunter loot and Hunter marks are increased by 5x; traps attract creatures faster.
Fishing needs no bait and always grants an extra fish per catch.
Anachronia and Havenhythe Big Game Hunter creatures need no bait and are twice as slow to catch you.
Farm animals are 20x more common from their sources.
